subject: reasoning
question: Point A is 26 m to the south of Point B. Point C is 13 m to the east of Point B. Point C is 39 m to the north of Point D. Point D is 14 m to the west of Point E. Point F is 13 m to the north of Point E. Point G is 40 m to the west of Point F. Point H is to the north of Point G and also to the west of Point C. In which direction is Point H with respect to Point F?
solution:
The distance and direction diagram as per the given information: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f501091269fb6b13dc8554d7fa817c5ac8a30168374056e2fb08cdf11d97c860.png] 

Here, the point H is in the **North-West** direction to the point F.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
